Libraries distributed with this game
====================================

SDL 3 (all packages)
    zlib license. Copyright (C) 1997-2026 Sam Lantinga.
    Source: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL

FluidSynth (Windows and macOS packages)
    GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
    Source: https://github.com/FluidSynth/fluidsynth
    The game uses it as a separate shared library; you may replace it with
    your own build of the same version.

libsndfile (Windows and macOS packages)
    GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
    Source: https://github.com/libsndfile/libsndfile

macOS packages also include the libraries Homebrew's SDL3 and FluidSynth
depend on, in the libs folder. Each keeps its own license; their sources are
listed at https://formulae.brew.sh/.
